title: Missing the Margins: A Systematic Literature Review on the Demographic Representativeness of LLMs
benchmark_measurement: This paper is a systematic literature review and does not introduce a new benchmark. It analyzes how 211 existing papers measure and report the demographic representativeness of LLMs. For religion, it measures how frequently it is included as a demographic category in these studies and summarizes their conclusions on whether LLMs are representative of different religious groups.
findings: Religion is a moderately studied demographic category in LLM representativeness research, studied more frequently than categories like disability or sexuality but less than gender or race. The review finds that, similar to other demographic categories, studies focusing on religion often lack methodological rigor (e.g., failing to conduct disaggregated analysis), which may lead to an inflated perception of LLM representativeness for religious groups.
